claims.claim: QUALCOMM Incorporated identity/NASDAQ tradability are validated; FY26 Q3 SEC/issuer evidence is primary and September Amazon collaboration is issuer evidence, not independent corroboration.

unknowns.unknown: Data-center incremental economics and conversion remain prospective.

thesisQuality.basis: Low-power compute/connectivity leadership plus automotive, IoT and data-center programs supports durable differentiation with handset/custom-silicon risks.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q3 revenue fell 4% and non-GAAP EPS fell 20% YoY while automotive+IoT revenue grew 28%.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current IR quote around $161 plus diversified targets offers plausible upside but requires substantial execution.

catalystScore.basis: Amazon AI-data-center collaboration, data-center ramp, automotive pipeline and edge-AI roadmap are multiple identifiable catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Management set measurable diversification targets and maintained capital returns; execution remains prospective.

alignment2036.basis: AI compute, connectivity, automotive, robotics and data-center infrastructure are foundational across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Common compute/connectivity/IP spans handsets, automotive, IoT, robotics, PCs and data centers.

bottleneckControl.basis: Wireless/connectivity IP and power-efficient compute participate in high-value qualification and infrastructure constraints.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Edge/cloud diversification creates multiple paths, offset by handset concentration and data-center execution dependence.

substitutionResilience.basis: Patent/IP and system integration create barriers, offset by in-house silicon and competing architectures.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Q3 cited challenging memory and supply conditions; fabless diversification helps but external dependencies remain.

pricingPower.basis: Licensing/IP economics and premium silicon support value capture, though current earnings pressure caps the score.

riskEvidence.basis: Handset concentration, memory/supply constraints, in-house silicon and unproven data-center economics can offset diversification upside.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current SEC results, issuer operating data, named-customer collaboration and current quote cover core thesis; segment incremental margins/data-center economics remain unproven.
